findings.description: The master script starts with 02_cleaning.do, which requires five raw ATUS datasets missing from the supplied package: atusrost0319.dta, atuscps0319.dta, atusresp0319.dta, atussum0319.dta and atusact0319.dta. The only ATUS file supplied is the downstream atusall0319.dta intermediate.
findings.evidence: Run log logs/pipeline-run.log records the five absent inputs and exit status 2.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the five raw ATUS datasets identified in the package README, or publish a self-contained reproducibility package with the required intermediate inputs.

findings.description: The imputation script merges a federal poverty-threshold dataset at draft/nature/check/federal_poverty_threshold.dta, which is not present in the package. Its hard-coded relative path also does not match the supplied package structure.
findings.evidence: 05_imputation.do line 77; package file inventory contains no poverty-threshold dataset.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the threshold dataset and document its source and expected location.

findings.description: Stata is unavailable. The R translation attempted the master execution order and input loading check, then stopped before analysis because required source data were missing. No reported estimates were recomputed.
findings.suggested_fix: After supplying the required data, complete the direct R translation and rerun the full pipeline.

limitations: This is a benchmark-mode reproduction check, not a robustness study; outcome_robustness is not checked.

The supplied article PDF is the author-formatted article and supplementary material. The claims listed here capture headline values and selected table values; a full cell-by-cell inventory of all numeric content was not completed. This is a limitation of this certificate.
No original code or data were uploaded. The local package was read only; only the reproduction bundle was written.
